scope: All 197 whole-token dobiv- forms in the Latin Noether reader: 188 finite obtain/get/derive/result forms and nine passive obtained/derived participles.
choice: Normalize finite forms to official dobyvati and passive forms to the dobyti participial paradigm, preserving inflection and capitalization.
motivation: Every occurrence denotes mathematical obtaining or derivation. Official type-1 dobyvati/dobyti spans West, South, and East comparators; no official dobiv- headword exists.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining dobiv- preserves a zero-headword source layer.
Dostav- is semantically overloaded with deliver/download/suffice.
Poluč- would reverse the established anti-East-collapse terminology decision.
A blind i-to-y spelling substitution would create malformed passive forms instead of dobyty/dobyta/dobyte.

evidence.official_dictionary: isv_words_list.csv SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: ids3191 dobyvati and 3192 dobyti, both type 1.
evidence.semantic_review: All 197 sites were replayed in sentence context; none means win, delivery, download, or sufficiency.
evidence.cohort_evidence: Czech, Slovene and Bosnian mathematical sources independently support obtain/result cognates or participles; official Belarusian evidence supplies the East bridge without token-mass voting.
evidence.baseline_correction: Direct exact scan found 27 pre-existing dobyv-/dobyt- tokens, correcting a preliminary 23-token estimate; the asserted post-total is therefore 224.

validation.coverage: 197/197 whole-token sites and exact 16-form source histogram
validation.protected_spans: zero comment, foreign, or foreignlanguage targets
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/refs/cites, braces, math delimiters, newlines, UTF-8 and final LF invariant
validation.reproducibility: frozen successor hashes reproduced before atomic apply
